title: Fix OpenAI-compatible provider API key unreachable (env var + setup mismatch)
description:
Fix OpenAI-compatible provider API key unreachable (Council-refined)

Source: audits/swarm-audit-synthesis-26-07-26.md (F: provider/key normalization)

Problem: Provider normalization and configuration reading path can make the OpenAI-compatible provider's API key unreachable (env/config mismatch). This task fixes the config load path, adds runtime diagnostics, and ensures provider selection honors runtime-available credentials.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add runtime diagnostic log lines when provider selected but API key not present
- Add unit tests for GetConfiguration provider resolution covering env-var, appsettings, and runtime-unavailable provider
- Add e2e check that startup logs provider+availability to `logs/` when no API key is present

Linked evidence: Data/Pages/audits/swarm-audit-synthesis-26-07-26.md#Top-Critical-Findings

Effort: 4-8h
